summary.text: Carol McEntee is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 33 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since June 16, 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2021-2022 legislative session McEntee chaired the Small Business Committee and was first vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee, and was also assigned to the Environment and Natural Resources Committee and the House Labor Committee.
